# PROCESS — cand_0005 (parent = champion cand_0001, val 0.600)

Diagnosed ALL 20 failing trajectories of the champion via 4 parallel read-only subagents
(groups A–D), separated ENV faults from capability failures, then shipped 2 SAFE, verified,
additive prose edits. This is a hard plateau (cand_0002/0003/0004 all REJECTED); the fixable
prose surface is nearly exhausted, so this iteration is narrow-but-clean, not broad-but-risky.

## Failure taxonomy of the 20 champion fails (this iteration's trajectories)
| category | tasks | prose-fixable? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ENV fault (recalc infra / volatile RANDBETWEEN / recalc-hostile array formula) | 73-45, 56996, 47741 | NO — handed back |
| Inconsistent-gold (gold contradicts the instruction or its own worked example) | 59743, 50630, 5192, 53367, 51359 | NO |
| Logic / ambiguity / edge-case recount (multiple valid answers or divergent counting) | 39046, 3911, 325-44, 57090, 11842, 55931, 450-9, 56427, 56637, 57232 | NO (or only partial) |
| **Contract-miss: right value, wrong TYPE, single EMPTY target cell** | **51958** | **YES — fixed (Edit A)** |
| Recalc-hostile external-reference formula (mechanism) | 56637 (B col) | Partial — safe rule shipped (Edit B) |

## Changes made this iteration (2 edits, both task_template.md, both ADDITIVE/BOUNDED)
| # | cluster | lever (from system-prompt SKILL) | what & why it generalizes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | 51958 — reformat value INTO a date/time, target cell empty, gold = real datetime, agent wrote an f-string | KNOWLEDGE + NARROWING contract | New type-section bullet: when the instruction says CONVERT/STANDARDIZE/REFORMAT a value INTO a date/time and the target cell is currently EMPTY, write a REAL datetime (pattern via number_format), not a text rendering — but ONLY for empty cells you fill; never re-type/re-format a target cell that already holds a value. Generalizes to the class "reformat-into-date fills an empty cell". |
| B | 56637 (and any external-link formula) — a written formula whose inputs trace to `'[1]…'!` external workbook refs can't recalc → error/stale 0 | KNOWLEDGE gap + concrete method | New formula-section bullet: recognize the `[n]` external-reference token; don't leave such a formula in an answer cell — read the cached value (data_only=True) or recompute in Python and write the LITERAL. Generalizes to all external-link answer cells. |

## Verify-the-fix (evidence + counterfactual)
- Edit A → trace 51958: target B2 is EMPTY; agent wrote f-string `'09/08/21 10:06'`; grader: "1 cell(s) hold str where datetime was expected — write the real typed value rather than its text form." With Edit A the agent writes a real datetime into the empty B2 → type matches gold. CONTRACT match confirmed against the grader's TYPE line (datetime expected), not merely against old prompt wording.
- Edit B → trace 56637: agent copied/translated the `B12` IF-formula whose chain resolves through `=VLOOKUP($B$1,'[1]Order Data'!…)`; that external `[1]` link doesn't recalc headless → B5 → 0/error → whole IF cascade wrong. Edit B tells the agent to read the cached value / recompute and write the literal, removing the un-recalculable external link from the answer.

## Blast-radius (SAFE test — named, and behavioral)
- Edit A: BOUNDED (additive + condition-gated). Fires ONLY on "reformat a value INTO a date/time" instructions AND only for EMPTY target cells. Verified NOT to flip any passing task:
  - 58047 (passing, "convert the data format in Column G→H") is an order-code reformat, NOT a date → trigger does not fire.
  - 30709 (passing, date task) is the exact task cand_0002/0003/0004's reformat→date rule BROKE — but those broke it via a whole-range rewrite ("apply pattern via number_format" primed re-formatting E6:E10, which already hold gold datetimes). Edit A explicitly restricts to EMPTY cells and reinforces "never re-type a cell that already holds a value," so it CANNOT cause that overwrite. 30709's passing behavior (`if target.value is None:` fill-only) is reinforced, not flipped.
  - No other passing task is a reformat-into-date task (cand_0004 shipped the reformat→date trigger and broke ONLY 30709 among passing tasks — objective evidence the trigger's blast radius is exactly {30709}, which Edit A now neutralizes).
- Edit B: BOUNDED (additive + condition-gated to the `[n]` external-reference token). Verified NO passing task writes an external-reference formula (grepped every passing final code block for a written `=…[n]…!` formula — zero hits), so the rule is a no-op on all 30 passing tasks and only redirects the currently-failing external-link case.

## ENV faults handed back (NOT prompt defects — do not optimize against)
- 73-45: grader states "INFRASTRUCTURE: formula recalculation FAILED … Not a prompt defect." Recalc infra failure.
- 56996: source price columns are all `=RANDBETWEEN(...)`; the grader's recalc regenerates new randoms, so no fixed reference can ever match. Non-deterministic by construction.
- 47741: `_xlfn.TEXTJOIN` nesting `TEXT(WORKDAY(…,array,…))` over an ArrayFormula input; the grader's LibreOffice recalc leaves it unresolved → error string regardless of prompt. Recalc-hostile.
Human/harness fix needed: recalc reliability + volatile/array-function handling.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — protecting the candidate from a net-zero regression)
- 38332 & the formula→literal cluster: the NARROW "spill-reference→literal" rule was SHIPPED in cand_0004 and did NOT fix 38332 (refuted). A BROAD "always write literal instead of a formula" rule is UNBOUNDED and DANGEROUS — passing tasks 58109 (`=SUMIFS(…WORKDAY…)`), 16511 (`=COUNTIF`), 55667 (`=IFERROR(INDEX…)`) write LIVE formulas and pass; forcing them to Python literals risks divergence on hidden copies. Skipped both directions.
- 51359 (leave non-blank target untouched): would fix it but directly contradicts the "recompute every answer yourself" worked-example guidance and MEMORY's warning that blanket leave-untouched regresses worked-example/dedup tasks. High-risk coin-flip → skipped.
- 5192 (reorder text, keep all chars): inconsistent-gold (the instruction's own two examples disagree on the marker letter); cand_0002 already shipped a worked-example-contradiction rule targeting 5192 and did NOT fix it → low confidence, skipped.
- 39046, 3911, 325-44, 57090, 11842, 55931, 450-9, 56427, 57232, 53367, 59743, 50630: logic/ambiguity or inconsistent-gold — not knowledge gaps; prose can only fix them by hardcoding or by a rule that regresses the class.

## Process & features used
- 4 parallel read-only diagnostic subagents over the failing traces (groups A–D); synthesized clusters, then verified each candidate edit's blast radius directly (grep of passing final-code for external-ref formulas; inspection of 58047/30709 date handling; inspection of passing live-formula writers 58109/16511/55667).
- Prior iterations read in full: LEDGER, JOURNAL (all 4 entries + RESULT lines), RUNMAP.
